_comment: The committed isolation policy of the sandboxes.
app_spec.xml, Untrusted Code Sandbox, feature 157:
System rejects a run of agent-authored code configured without
gVisor isolation
(docs/nullius-tech-architecture.md section 5.2: LLM-authored code is
untrusted code, treat it that way; the isolation row of that
section's control table is 'gVisor (runsc) or Firecracker microVM';
section 18: Sandbox | gVisor runsc | container-native, far lighter
than a VM per call; section 17: Z1 sandboxes, egress denied by
default).
The compile in packages/sandbox/src/sandbox/isolation.py refuses this
file and any change to it that gives a component a mechanism other
than gvisor, or a runtime other than runsc - so the two strings below
are not a convention the next edit can forget: they are the law,
checked, and every component Z1 runs is listed here rather than
named at a call site.
The two components are the same two boxes feature 148's committed
credential grant and feature 149's committed egress policy carry, so
the isolation law, the credential law and the egress posture cover
exactly one membership.
